title: Declare RoutingEngine header and scratch buffers
description:
Create Source/DSP/RoutingEngine.h only (header-first Wave 1).

Declare Module C, the Routing / Matrix engine API:
- RoutingMode enum for the three ROUTING_MODE values: SerialMaximizerThenExciter, SerialExciterThenMaximizer, ParallelMatrixBlend.
- Class RoutingEngine that owns invocation order and crossfade summing (does not implement Maximizer/Exciter DSP itself).
- Pre-allocated per-channel scratch buffers sized in prepareToPlay from samplesPerBlock and channel count; no heap allocation in process().
- juce::SmoothedValue<float> for PARALLEL_BLEND (K) so mode/blend changes do not click.
- prepare(double sampleRate, int samplesPerBlock, int numChannels) and process(...) signatures that accept references/pointers to the maximizer and exciter modules and the current ROUTING_MODE / PARALLEL_BLEND targets.
- Real-time contract in comments/API: no locks, no allocation, no blocking I/O on the audio path; mode switches must not reallocate.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/DSP/ (Maximizer / Exciter headers from phases b and c if present)
- Source/PluginProcessor.h for APVTS parameter IDs ROUTING_MODE and PARALLEL_BLEND
- CMakeLists.txt for target layout
- Any existing DSP header style (include guards, JUCE includes, prepare/process patterns)

Do not infer APIs from this description alone; match existing project conventions after inspection.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY Source/DSP/RoutingEngine.h. Do not create the .cpp, edit PluginProcessor, or change other DSP modules.
acceptance_criteria: Source/DSP/RoutingEngine.h declares RoutingMode with three modes (serial max->exc, serial exc->max, parallel blend)
Source/DSP/RoutingEngine.h declares RoutingEngine with prepare/process signatures and SmoothedValue blend and pre-allocated scratch buffer members
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: implement DSP bodies in the header beyond inline accessors
allocate on the audio thread or introduce locks in the declared API

allowed: header-only API matching existing DSP module header style
pre-declare scratch AudioBuffer or heap arrays filled in prepare
forbidden: implement process body in .cpp in this task
rewire APVTS or PluginProcessor in this task
introduce a new routing framework or graph library
